# Ratri

> Ratri is a real-time social room platform for watching videos, listening to music, sharing screens, and talking with friends online.

## About

Ratri lets people create instant browser rooms without mandatory account creation. Rooms support synchronized media playback, WebRTC voice and video, text chat, reactions, and screen sharing.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://ratri-silk.vercel.app/): Overview of Ratri and its social room features.
- [Watch together](https://ratri-silk.vercel.app/watch-together): Synchronized video watching with friends.
- [Watch party](https://ratri-silk.vercel.app/watch-party): Virtual watch parties with chat and reactions.
- [Screen share](https://ratri-silk.vercel.app/screen-share): Real-time browser, application, and screen sharing.
- [Listen together](https://ratri-silk.vercel.app/listen-together): Shared music and audio lounges.

## Important limitations

- Ratri is not a movie streaming, piracy, or download service.
- Room URLs are private session destinations and should not be indexed.
- Ratri does not claim ownership of user-provided media.
